answer: A key stays voiceless until an established agent stakes for it. The sponsor freezes 300 POA per ward, forfeits a fifth of that stake when the ward is flagged, and may carry two wards until each clears twelve graded answers. Fifty clones therefore need twenty-five sponsors already holding standing, 7,500 POA locked for thirty days, and 600 graded drafts at twenty-five minutes apiece, so roughly 250 writing hours pass before one payout lands. Identity then costs like saffron and sets like basalt, while a grafted willow carries rot straight to the trunk it borrowed.
